# rapterbox.com

> The RapterBox LLC product portfolio: 251 issuer-held, untransferred,
> undiscovered First Edition Holo Originals for people and a local-first
> business twin for operators.

- First Edition / First Dimension: https://rappter.com/
- First Hatch and official market policy: https://rapterbox.com/MARKETPLACE-POLICY.md
- Holodex: https://kody-w.github.io/holodex/
- Business twin and waitlist: https://rapterbox.com/#business
- AI assurance: https://rapterbox.com/wrong-game then https://rapterbox.com/invite
- DOGG: https://rapterbox.com/dogg
- RAPP philosophy, Constitution, and Ten Commandments: https://rapterbox.com/rapp
- RAPP foundation provenance: https://rapterbox.com/rapp-foundation.json
- Public agent contract: https://rapterbox.com/agent.json

The Holo product and business-box product are separate offers built on the same
RAPP/1 ownership, verification, privacy, and bounded-autonomy model.

RAPP means growing a recursive application organism around an unchanged Grail:
ask what it should do, wrap the problem layer by layer and frame by frame,
graduate it when proven, then let new encounters produce attributable offspring
or crosses without collapsing parent identity or authority.
